description: Modify booking details like passenger info, date/time, flight number, or special requests. Ask the customer for BOTH their booking reference AND the email address used at booking — same as our website manage-booking login. Do not call this tool without both values.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — either "APL-<LT reservation id>" (e.g. "APL-1013869", as on the confirmation email) or the numeric LT reservation ID (e.g. "966244"). Both formats accepted.

changes.description: Object containing the fields to change

passenger_phone.description: New phone number with country code

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly

name: amend_booking
